name: Kolhapuri Tadka Restaurant-Bur Dubai | Best Indian Restaurant in Dubai
address: Metro Station - Food Court-Al Khaleej Centre - Al Mankhool Rd - beside Sony - Al Raffa - Dubai Sharaf DG - Exit 2 - Al Fahidi - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Experience the best and most delicious Maharashtrian Kolhapuri Tambda and Pandhra Rassa, along with authentic Konkani, Malvani, and Goan cuisine. Enjoy pure Dhaba-style flavors, Gava Kadcha Bet, and a homemade taste. At Kolhapuri Tadka Restaurant – Dubai, the Best Maharashtrian Restaurant in Dubai, we bring you the finest Indian dining experience with special homemade recipes and expertise in non-veg delicacies.

reviews.author: Shubh Sam
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Had a great experience at Kolhapuri Tadka! The food was very delicious, fresh, and full of authentic flavors. Every dish was well prepared and tasted amazing. The staff were friendly, and the service was quick. If you’re looking for tasty Indian food, I highly recommend this place. Will definitely visit again!

reviews.author: Amey Panchal (AmeyLiveSound)
reviews.text:
Kolhapuri Tadka is our go-to place whenever we crave authentic, home-cooked-style food. The food genuinely feels like eating at home rather than eating at a restaurant, which is what makes this place special.

Their thalis have always been a solid 10/10 for us. The taste, homely flavours, and overall quality have been consistently good.

However, we recently ordered the Batata Bhaji, and unfortunately, it was a total disappointment. The potato slices were far too thick and had a very thick coating. They also seemed to have not been properly drained after frying, as there was an excessive amount of oil. We actually had to place tissue paper underneath the dish to absorb the excess oil.

One small suggestion for the management: since the restaurant is located inside the food court of a shopping centre and the food is traditionally eaten with hands, it would be helpful to have tissue paper or paper towels available in the washroom. After enjoying a thali, washing your hands is obviously necessary, and having tissues available would make the experience much more convenient.

Overall, we still love Kolhapuri Tadka for its authentic, homely food and especially the thalis. Just a couple of small improvements would make the experience even better.

reviews.author: Monty Wadkar
reviews.text: Kolhapuri Tadka Restaurant is a must-visit if you’re craving authentic Kolhapuri and spicy Marathi-style food. The owner is very nice and welcoming. I love it and highly recommend it to anyone who enjoys flavorful, traditional food!

reviews.text: The food was incredible and very tasty, it bought back memories with every bite of it. It felt like home cooked meals. reviews.author: Anjali Iynath
reviews.text:
This is my first time trying authentic Maharashtrian cuisine, and I must say that it really blew my mind away.
I went to their branch in bur Dubai- which was inside Al khaleej centre inside a food court. However, the service was par excellence. I felt like I was inside a restaurant with Mr Sulaiman’s prompt response and delivery for each and everything I asked.
I ordered Non-veg Vade thaali which comprised of bajra-jowar roti/ chicken sukha/ normal thick gravy along with rice and other condiments.
Every dish- was delicious.  For the South-Indian in me, it was truly a delightful experience exploring this new cuisine.

Would 100% come back to this place.

reviews.text: I think their chef is changed now . I ordered mutton kolhapuri thali today but the taste was not good at all as usual . If your chef is changed please bring him back please don't compromise on the taste  or please hire someone good who cooks exactly like the previous one . I'm very upset today .

reviews.author: Sid Pawar
reviews.text:
Had a good experience at Kolhapuri Tadka Restaurant in Bur Dubai. If you are looking for authentic Marathi-style food, this place is definitely worth trying. The taste was good, and the pricing felt reasonable for the quality and quantity offered.

Marathi people who miss home-style flavors can surely give this place a try. The food had a nice authentic touch and overall the dining experience was enjoyable.

Giving 4/5 mainly because service can take a little time, sometimes 20 minutes or more for the order. However, I feel they may be preparing the food fresh after ordering, which could be their policy for maintaining quality — so I may be wrong in judging the waiting time.

Overall, a good experience with tasty food, reasonable prices, and authentic Marathi flavors. Recommended for Marathi food lovers in Dubai.

reviews.author: Sakshi Kamble
reviews.text: Absolutely loved the authentic Maharashtrian flavors! From the perfectly spiced misal pav to the soft bhakris and delicious puran poli, every dish felt homemade and full of tradition. The ambience had a warm Marathi touch and the staff was extremely welcoming and attentive. A perfect place for anyone craving real Maharashtrian food with great taste and quality. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: zaara mohd
reviews.text:
If you’ve ever wondered where to find authentic Marathi cuisine, look no further! This place offers an incredible variety of traditional dishes that are not only delicious but also reasonably priced. One of my personal favorites is their rice flour roti, which perfectly complements the flavorful meals they serve.

Their menu features an amazing selection of thalis, with options for fish, chicken, mutton, and vegetarian dishes. Each thali is a delightful experience, showcasing the rich flavors of Marathi cooking that you’ll surely enjoy.

For your convenience, there is ample parking available both inside the mall and in the nearby RTA parking area. Plus, if you prefer to dine at home, they also offer home delivery, making it easy to enjoy quality Marathi food wherever you are. Don’t miss the chance to indulge in this culinary gem!

reviews.author: Vijay Kodag
reviews.text: Had a great time at Kolhapur Tadaka! The food quality is excellent. Both the Veg and Non-Veg Thalis are amazing. The Chicken Jatra Thali with Jawar Bhakri is my favorite—super tasty and filling. The Chicken Kala Thali is also really good, with great flavor. And the Chicken Hyderabad Biryani is delicious too. Definitely recommend this place for anyone who loves great food!

reviews.author: Rupesh Moudekar
reviews.text:
Absolutely disappointing experience. We ordered the mutton thali and mutton kharda thali, expecting authentic flavors from a Kolhapuri restaurant—but it was a complete letdown. The so-called “kharda” had nothing remotely close to the actual taste or spice it’s known for.

It became quite obvious that the food wasn’t freshly prepared. The curries seemed pre-cooked, stored, and simply reheated upon order. When customers are paying premium prices, the least you can do is serve fresh, properly made food. The only redeeming factor was the bhakri, which was at least served fresh.

To make matters worse, they charged an additional 10% per thali claiming price hikes, yet neither the menu nor the bill reflected these updated prices. This feels misleading and unprofessional.

If you cannot serve authentic Kolhapuri food, at the very least don’t misuse the name and reputation of Kolhapur. Truly disappointing.

reviews.author: Sneha Hengade
reviews.text: We ordered the spcl kholapuri mutton thali and the chicken wade thali. Authentic kholapuri taste and spice level. The tamba, pandhara rassa was to die for. This location is in a food court so dont expect ambience, but you will not be dissapointed with the food and the service. They come to your table to take orders and attend to you just like they would at a proper restaurant setup.
